def slug(text):
    """Convert text to lowercase ASCII, preserve digits, replace runs of other characters with one hyphen, and strip edge hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    import re
    result = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '-', text)
    result = result.strip('-')
    return result
